providerKeys.title: Provider Keys
providerKeys.description: These keys will be used to authenticate with your provider.
providerKeys.portalDescription: The key you enter will be added within the `Authorization` header of your API requests. Select which key you want to associate with this organization

proxyKeys.title: Helicone Proxy Keys
proxyKeys.description: These keys will replace your provider keys in your application. This ensures that any usage will be logged in Helicone.

createProviderKey.title: Create Provider Key
createProviderKey.providerKeyTooltip: This is the secret key that you get from the provider. It is used to authenticate and make requests to the provider's API.
createProviderKey.authHeaderHint: This will be placed in the authorization header with the Bearer prefix.

createProxyKey.title: Create Proxy Key
createProxyKey.yourKeyDescription: Please copy this key and store it somewhere safe. You will not be able to see it again.

deleteProviderKey.title: Delete Provider Key
deleteProviderKey.description: This Provider Key will be deleted from your account. All proxy keys that are mapped to this provider key will be deleted as well. Are you sure you want to delete this provider key?

deleteProxyKey.title: Delete Proxy Key
deleteProxyKey.description: This Proxy Key will be deleted from your account. Are you sure you want to delete this proxy key?
